commands: sh -c 'X11F_GREP=$(grep -i X11Forwarding /etc/ssh/sshd_config); X11F_GREP_RC=$?; if [ "$X11F_GREP_RC" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$X11F_GREP_RC"; fi; printf "%s\n" "$X11F_GREP" | grep -v "^#"'
blurb: This check verifies that the SSH daemon has X11 forwarding turned off. When X11Forwarding is missing or set to yes, graphical sessions can be tunneled through SSH.
